item.title: Israel faces pressure to end Iran strikes as US pushes ceasefire-for-talks option
item.description: Officials say Washington is pressing for the war to wind down within days to allow possible US-Iran negotiations, even as Israel doubts a deal is likely and sees potential American ground action as a preferable next step

item.title: Iran targets southern Israel: impacts in Be'er Sheva, industrial plant hit in Neot Hovav
item.description: Workers told to shelter as crews respond to chemical leak following missile strike Emergency teams assess risks after hazardous materials leak at industrial zone in southern Israel

item.title: Sister of American IDF soldier says family chose Israel burial out of pride in his path
item.description: Sgt. Moshe Yitzchak Hacohen Katz, a Hasidic Jew serving in the Paratroopers Brigade’s 890th Battalion, was killed by Hezbollah rocket fire targeting IDF forces operating in southern Lebanon

item.title: American IDF Sgt. Moshe Yitzchak Hacohen Katz killed in southern Lebanon
item.description: Katz, a Chabad Jew from New Haven, Connecticut, moved to Israel to enlist in Paratroopers’ 890th Battalion; three others were wounded in the same Hezbollah rocket attack

item.title: קלוד תחת אש: טראמפ רוצה לזרוק, אבל הצבא חייב אותו
item.description: אחרי שהקריס את המניות של ענקיות הטק והציב איום על פרנסתם של המתכנתים, מודל ה–AI "קלוד" מחולל מהפכה גם במלחמה עם איראן ועוזר לצבא האמריקאי לשפר את הביצועים. אנת'רופיק, המפתחת שלו, מתעקשת להגדיר קווים מוסריים לשימוש בו ומוציאה את טראמפ מהכלים

item.title: Fourth round of sirens since morning hits southern Israel; Home Front Command extends restrictions
item.description: Sirens sounded for the fourth time since morning across southern Israel after launches from Iran, as the Home Front Command said restrictions will remain in place through Saturday following a situational assessment

item.title: Iran missile fire sets off sirens in Dimona, Dead Sea
item.description: Air defenses shoot down threat approaching southern Israel; air raid alerts activated across Haifa after Lebanon rocket fire

item.title: 'We didn’t believe this could happen': Widespread damage after Iranian cluster missile hits Be'er Sheva
item.description: At least five people were lightly wounded by an Iranian missile, two hours after a strike on an Adama factory in Neot Hovav, with minor damage to Hapoel Be'er Sheva’s training complex and homes destroyed in the Nahal Ashan neighborhood

item.title: Lebanon operation could last years, officials say
item.description: Forces operate under heavy rocket and anti-tank fire as Hezbollah continues attacks; military says troops may remain in southern Lebanon even if a ceasefire is reached

item.title: IDF chief Zamir condemns CNN incident as ‘serious failure,’ vows zero tolerance for revenge rhetoric
item.description: After suspending entire reserve battalion, army chief says soldiers’ conduct and remarks toward journalists breached IDF values and harmed Israel’s legitimacy; probe into incident continues
